title: Health insurance and the family doctor

text: In Germany, Austria and Switzerland almost everyone has health insurance. In Germany most people are insured with a public insurer (Krankenkasse) and show an insurance card at the surgery. Visitors from the UK should check cover before they travel.

You usually start with a family doctor (Hausarzt), who refers you to a specialist (Facharzt) if needed. You normally need an appointment, and waiting rooms can be full. In an emergency, call 112. For an on-call doctor outside surgery hours in Germany, call 116 117.
